Name: Vanilla Refreshed - Mature Singles
Author: TariVendice
Description:
Vanilla Refreshed Mature SIngles is an extension of my Vanilla Refreshed series and specifically built to be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking for Love[/url]. It retouches most of the dateable characters in LFL while still keeping what makes them the characters we love.

[list]
[*][b]Clint[/b] - I gave him a full beard and a some more muscle (blacksmithing is hard work!), as well as neater hair. His blacksmithing apron also got more detail.
[*][b]Gus[/b] - Cleaned up his hair and mustache. His face has also been cleaned up some, so he has a jawline. He has a configurable blue shirt.
[*][b]Lewis[/b] - I desaturated and darkened his clothes, as well as removed his mustache and darkened his hair.
[*][b]Linus[/b] - I gave him less bulky shoulders, longer hair, and changed his beard. His beard is also configurable to be shaved.
[*][b]Marnie[/b] - Marnie got a full makeover: neater hair, new clothes, and lips that match the rest of the ladies in the game.
[*][b]Pam[/b] - I lightened and lengthened her hair, touched up her face, and also gave her configurable red hair to match Penny better.
[*][b]Willy[/b] - Willy went from full beard to scruff and his shirt changed to a deep, ocean blue.
[*][b]Marlon[/b] - Added 12/17/23. Marlon got more pronounced scars, cleaner hair, shorter facial hair, and new clothes! His portrait will automatically read whether you need a vanilla, SVE, or Make Marlon Real portrait.
[/list]
All characters have also been given slight (and not-so-slight) tweaks to their faces/necks to give them a cleaner look. Beach portraits are also included. This mod was built around [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking for Love[/url], but vanilla portraits are included and this mod will work well whether you have LFL installed or not. I highly recommend having [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] installed to tinker with the config settings for my mod as well as LFL if you have it installed.

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
[*]Download the main file and unzip it.
[*]Move the folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[*]That's it!
[/list]
[b]Recommended Mods:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking for Love[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14917]Seasonal Magnus Rasmodius[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17296]Pam and Gus Get a Happy Ending﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]

[b]Possible Future Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sandy Portrait
[*]Wizard Portrait (This one is less likely because [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14917]Seasonal Magnus Rasmodius[/url]﻿ already exists, which is, in my opinion, the perfect Wizard portrait mod. I highly recommend that you download it.)
[*]matching sprites
[*]winter portraits/sprites (post 1.6 release)
[/list]
